requirements.text: Execute all 619 active instruction identities.
Return -UNSUPPORTED for the three assigned-dark identities.
Match the consensus oracle produced by the soc, bare, and hosted-dev profiles.
Implement scalar binary32/binary64 FP and the VLEN=512 vector/mask profile.
Implement every instruction-exposed engine protocol and object class.
Expose four cores with four resident contexts each.
Preserve coherent atomics, futex wakeup, and forward progress across sixteen threads.
Accept valid UART images and reject invalid UART images before execution.
Accept valid SDHC images from LBA 2048 and reject corrupted images.
Enter JTAG halt for boot selection 2 and reject reserved boot selection 3.
Initialize, read, write, and refresh the external SDR SDRAM.
Transmit and receive UART frames at the specified baud rate.
Operate the native four-bit SDHC command and data interface.
Train and enumerate PCIe, expose BAR0 and MSI, and perform authorized bidirectional DMA.
Reject DMA after acknowledged IOMMU revocation without modifying host memory.
Implement timer, interrupt/event, conditioned-entropy, and Hash_DRBG semantics.
Implement JTAG target selection, halt/resume, register access, and memory access for all sixteen contexts.
Elaborate with no unresolved hierarchy, inferred latches, or Yosys structural errors.
Complete GF180MCU placement and routing with zero detailed-routing DRC errors.
Report no setup violations under the frozen multi-clock SDC.
Pass reserved-boot and JTAG checks on the unmodified mapped netlist.
Fail closed on missing gates, malformed RewardKit output, and incomplete candidates.

scenarios.stimulus: All 459 frozen program/data pairs, covering every active and assigned-dark identity.
scenarios.oracle: three-profile emulator consensus plus the guest assertions in each microprogram

scenarios.stimulus: Sixteen threads rendezvous, use release/acquire operations, futexes, and coherent AMOs, then exit.
scenarios.oracle: directed 4x4 SMP program and frozen three-profile reference run

scenarios.stimulus: Select all four cores and four contexts; halt, write/read registers and memory, resume, and inspect status.
Boot a valid framed UART image, reject an invalid image, execute SDRAM traffic, and transmit a result byte.
scenarios.oracle: boot-image module, pin-level UART peer, and cycle-checked SDRAM model

scenarios.stimulus: Read one valid and one CRC-corrupted boot sector through native four-bit SD mode.
scenarios.oracle: pin-level SDHC card model and boot-image module

scenarios.stimulus: Train Gen1 x1, enumerate configuration space, probe/program BAR0, enable MSI and bus mastering, run both DMA directions, revoke the IOVA, and retry DMA.
scenarios.oracle: pinned public PCIe root model plus the directed LNP64 IOMMU program

scenarios.stimulus: Run the frozen Yosys and LibreLane GF180 flow through post-route STA, then simulate the mapped netlist.
scenarios.oracle: strict release-flow exit status and parsed tool metrics

scenarios.stimulus: Mutate RewardKit outputs and run the intentionally incomplete mini candidate.
